QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR META ADS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Meta Ads cost in Kilkenny?

Management from €1,500 a month, ad spend separate. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Kilkenny?
Yes. We work with businesses in Kilkenny and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
What budget do I need for Meta Ads?
We recommend a minimum of €1,500/month ad spend. Below this level, it's difficult to generate enough data for meaningful optimisation.
Do I need to provide creative?
We provide creative direction and briefs. You can produce the assets (we'll guide you) or we can arrange production through our network of content creators.
Can you set up the Meta Pixel?
Yes. Pixel installation, event tracking, and Conversions API setup are all included in onboarding.
How is your reporting different?
We use multi-touch attribution models and cross-reference Meta data with Google Analytics and CRM data to give you an accurate picture of Meta's true contribution to revenue.
